stories.title: DB + Auth: admin role, change password, promote
stories.acceptance_criteria: Add 'admin' to role CHECK in users table. Auth: change_password_self(user_id, current, new), change_password_for_user(actor, target, new) with rules: self=own with current pass; manager=employees only; admin=anyone. promote_to_admin(actor, target): only if actor is admin OR (no admins and actor is manager and target is self). count_admins(), is_admin_or_manager(). Manager dashboard access for admin.

stories.title: UI: Change password, Reset password, Promote to admin
stories.acceptance_criteria: Sidebar: 'Change my password' for all users (current, new, confirm). Manage Users: 'Reset password' per user — managers see it for employees only; admins see it for everyone. 'Promote to admin' — manager sees for self when no admins; admin sees for managers when admins exist.
